title: Energy Marshals
description:
**Energy Marshal**

**Location:** Virginia, USA  
**Industry:** Data Centres / Mission-Critical Infrastructure  
**Focus:** Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) Coordination & Commissioning

**Role Overview**

We are seeking an experienced **Energy Marshal** to support the safe delivery, testing and commissioning of electrical and mechanical systems on a large-scale data centre project. The successful candidate will take responsibility for coordinating Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) activities, managing energy isolation procedures and ensuring all works are carried out safely during construction, testing, commissioning and system handover.

Working closely with commissioning teams, electrical and mechanical contractors, site management and QA/QC personnel, the Energy Marshal will play a key role in controlling hazardous energy, preventing unsafe interactions between live systems and ongoing works, and maintaining a safe working environment across a complex, mission-critical site.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **LOTO Coordination:** Coordinate and oversee Lockout/Tagout procedures, ensuring equipment and systems are correctly isolated, locked, tagged and verified before work begins.
* **Energy Isolation Management:** Manage energy isolation activities across electrical and mechanical systems, including switchgear, transformers, UPS systems, generators, distribution equipment, pumps and HVAC plant.
* **Commissioning Support:** Work closely with commissioning managers and engineers to ensure safe isolation and energisation during pre-commissioning, functional testing, integrated systems testing (IST) and final commissioning.
* **Energisation Planning:** Coordinate planned energisation activities, ensuring isolation boundaries, switching sequences, permits and safety controls are clearly defined and communicated.
* **Permit-to-Work (PTW):** Review and coordinate permits, risk assessments, method statements and associated safety documentation for commissioning and maintenance activities.
